verdict.rationale: Gitea lets users choose where data lives in two documented ways. It is a free, self-hosted Git service offering "full control" that can be deployed on your own servers, and its managed offering explicitly lets customers "Choose your provider and region." Missing for 10: details of which regions/providers are available, formal data-residency guarantees for the managed service, and independent or hands-on corroboration of region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Launch a managed environment for teams that want speed, support, and low operational overhead. Choose your provider and region
